description: Golden test cases for DevChat evaluation

test_cases.question: What is a conditional cash transfer?
test_cases.expected_answer: A conditional cash transfer (CCT) is a social welfare program that provides cash payments to recipients contingent on them meeting certain conditions, typically related to education (school attendance) or health (vaccination, medical checkups).

test_cases.question: What is an RCT?
test_cases.expected_answer: A randomized controlled trial (RCT) is a research design where participants are randomly assigned to treatment or control groups to evaluate the causal effect of an intervention.
